RudeBoy – Still Holding On is an emotional Afrobeats-inspired love song about refusing to give up when love becomes difficult. The song explores heartbreak, memories, loyalty, longing, hope, and the determination to keep believing in a relationship despite pain and uncertainty.

With melodic vocals, powerful African rhythms, deep bass, steady drums, rhythmic percussion, shakers, warm keyboards, and emotional harmonies, “Still Holding On” delivers a heartfelt message about love that refuses to disappear.

RudeBoy is used as a creative reference for the musical direction and performance concept.
